harnessDefects.assertion: policy cache TTL expiry: valid/404 <24h, failures 5min, and 'no expired allow on refresh failure'
harnessDefects.reason: No public surface exposes a clock or the cache format, so expiry cannot be forced deterministically (module-private gate, no injectable time source).
harnessDefects.remedy: If the gate accepts an injectable time source in the same option bag as fetchImpl/lookupImpl, the expired-allow row becomes executable; the reviewer then folds it in as a new rubric version and re-freezes.
harnessDefects.scoringEffect: not scored today; the scored rows are in-process reuse, fresh-process reuse of the persisted policy, cold-path fail-closed, and no request inside a Retry-After window

harnessDefects.assertion: the live /api/v1/intelligence?view=jobs body shape (nesting, cursor parameter name, extra filters)
harnessDefects.reason: No network at authoring time, so the live response could not be observed. The offline fixture body IS the frozen contract; the cursor parameter name is deliberately not frozen (checks match on the cursor value), and the live smoke is advisory.
harnessDefects.remedy: A recorded live capture may be attached as advisory evidence; folding it into the score requires a rubric amendment that freezes the observed shape.
harnessDefects.scoringEffect: the scored contract is the fixture body; the live path is never scored

harnessDefects.reason: No public Hermes surface signs a session transcript. The checker asserts location (inside the disposable HERMES_HOME), currency (mtime inside the recorded run window) and byte-level agreement with the normalized record.
harnessDefects.remedy: None available through public surfaces; the claim stops at 'recorded and internally consistent'. Do not upgrade this check's wording without new evidence.
harnessDefects.scoringEffect: check #9 asserts structure, isolation and agreement; it does not assert authenticity

harnessDefects.reason: The environment is asserted from a hash-verified raw capture recorded during the run; the checker cannot inspect a process that has exited.
harnessDefects.remedy: Capture the environment inside the same process tree at run time (already required) and keep the capture hash-verified.
harnessDefects.scoringEffect: asserted from the capture, with secret-assignment scanning

harnessDefects.reason: The plan requires a byte cap but fixes no number, and no repo constant exists for the ohshi page fetch.
harnessDefects.remedy: None needed: the check uses an 8 MiB input, so any cap <= 8 MiB passes and no product constant is invented.

harnessDefects.assertion: direct unit assertions on the policy matcher and the gate itself
harnessDefects.reason: fetchPublicResource is module-private by design; exporting it for tests would widen the product surface for no runtime reason.
harnessDefects.remedy: None. Every check reaches the gate through the exported entry points that use it. A check that truly needs a new public seam is an escalation to the reviewer, not an implementation detail.
